_comment: bitGen Studio — the 🧩 Testing docker's checklist (lib/testPlan.js). auto = ticked by itself when the app sees it work; manual = you tick ✓ / ✗ (+ a note). Newest release first.

groups.title: 2.540.4 — 🧩 Settings ▸ Add-ons: install YuE2 in the app

items.title: Settings ▸ Add-ons lists YuE2 music and Viggle (native) - what each is for, needs, size, installed or not
⤓ Install YuE2: its log streams in the tab (venv, PyTorch 2.10 with CUDA, the pipeline) and ends ✓ installed
…then a song with the "YuE2" style in the Music docker (the first one downloads the model)
🗑 Remove takes the yue2 folder away again (and ⤓ Install brings it back)

groups.title: 2.540.0 — 🖼 Blender / Unreal renders made real with the reference docker's pictures (+ 3DREAL)

items.title: Timeline .blend → Render to real → 🖼 References: name a block "Car" in Blender, put a car picture in the reference docker - it is matched (auto); tick Use them, 🎬 Render to real: a first-frame job, then a 3DREAL job animates it
…pick a picture by hand in an object's dropdown (or "- no reference -") - it is kept for that .blend
Image editor 🧊 3D layer: 🖼 References lists the meshes; with pictures set, ✨ Generate from it makes a real picture as a new layer
Image editor Unreal Layer → 🎮 Unreal tab: 🔍 Find the objects (update the bridge to 1.3.0), pick pictures, ✨ Make it real → a new layer
Timeline Unreal clip → UNREAL ▸ Render to Real: 🔍 Find the objects, pictures, 🎬 → a first-frame job then a 3DREAL job

groups.title: 2.539.0 — 🖼 reference descriptions + wall / floor / furniture / light types, references in the house builder and the image editor

items.title: References docker: type a short description under a picture, a video and a sound - Save the project, reopen it: they are still there; the mapping line shows the picture's
A picture's Type dropdown has wall · floor · furniture · light
🏠 Drag a wall / floor picture from the References docker onto a wall or a room on the plan - the 3D view (and a 📷 shot) shows it; Tile (m) sizes it
🏠 A furniture / light picture on a piece (🖼 Looks like → From References…) - ✨ Make it real's prompt says "look exactly like the one in picture N" and sends it
🖼 Image editor: drag a reference picture onto an open picture - it comes in as a new layer named by its description
🖼 Image editor ✨ AI → Edit: pick a 'reference' (the dock's pictures) - the edit gets it as Picture 2 ("put the lamp from Picture 2 on the table")

groups.title: 2.538.0 — 🧩 ⤓ Civitai into each type's folder, 📁 model_folders.json, 🔄 Sync, 🏠 ◯ lights, ⛶ beside the side dockers

items.title: 🧩 Civitai tab: ⤓ on a card the first time for a type (e.g. SDXL LoRA) - the Select Folder dialog asks where; pick one and it downloads there
⤓ another model of the same type: no dialog - it goes straight to that folder (the downloads list shows it)
Shift+click ⤓: the dialog opens to change that type's folder (and downloads there)
📁 in the Models docker: every type's folder (model_folders.json) - Change…, ✕ forget, pick one for any type
🔄 Sync: Civitai's details + pictures for every model + LoRA on this computer (all tabs) - by version id / SHA-256 / file name
🏠 ◯ Light tool: press where it hangs, drag its reach - the plan shows the circle, the 3D view lights it (height, brightness, colour in the panel)
⛶ Maximize a docker with the Gallery / Queue / References / Assets open: it fills the room between them, not over them

groups.title: 2.537.0 — 🧩 Models: pages, folder tabs, card size, the info page, Civitai info for every model, This project

items.title: 🧩 Models with your 400+ models: a page holds what fits the docker (auto) - resize the docker and it refits; ‹ 1 2 … › and 24 / 48 / 96 / 200 a page
Folder tabs under Models / LoRAs: SDXL, Pony, Flux … (your folders inside checkpoints / loras, not 'checkpoints/SDXL') - each shows only its models
⇲ Edit: drag a card's corner (or the slider) - every card follows and the columns refill the docker; it is remembered
⤓ Civitai info: details, a thumbnail and example pictures arrive for your models (matched by file name) into model_info - another project shows them too
Hover a card, move onto its description card, click it: the info page (examples + their prompts, Use this prompt, ✓ Use this model, Civitai ↗, ‹ Back / Esc)
📌 This project: the models + LoRAs this project's renders used

groups.title: 2.536.0 — Veda sparse attention (an optional video accelerator)

items.title: Settings -> ComfyUI -> Video accelerators -> ⬇ Install Veda, then Settings -> Models -> Model catalog -> 'Veda predictor (MiniMax H3)'; restart ComfyUI (needs 0.38+)
A MiniMax H3 video style with Veda On renders; the log says 'accel: veda on -> h3veda' and which predictor
Same seed + prompt at 1344x768: time Veda On against Sage auto (and Off) - Veda should be clearly faster; note any softer faces
Veda Quality (denser) on a hero shot: closer to Veda off, still faster than Sage

groups.title: 2.535.0 — FLUX 3 Klein: an old ComfyUI is named as such

items.title: Update ComfyUI to 0.41.0 or newer (0.41.1+ best), restart it: a FLUX 3 Klein picture renders
Before updating: the error says 'flux3' is a CHOICE this ComfyUI does not offer, names the version it needs and how to update (not 'the file is not on a search path')

groups.title: 2.534.0 — 🧪 Test mode (it suggests, you confirm + suggest), new renders join the open preview

items.title: Settings -> General -> 🧪 Test mode: on = tests tick and are suggested where you are; off = nothing ticks, nothing pops up
Use something on the list: a small box asks 'Did it work?' - ✓ / ✗, what happened, and a suggestion to change the feature
In the image editor (or the House builder) a reminder says what to test next there; Later / Skip / ✕ move it along
A render finishing while the preview (lightbox) is open: it joins the strip and '✨ 1 new' takes you to it - the picture you are looking at stays

groups.title: Image editor - the everyday tools (each ticks when you use it in Test mode)

items.title: Filters -> Blur -> Gaussian Blur on a layer
🖌 Brush: paint a stroke (size, opacity, colour)
Eraser: rub part of a layer out
Make a selection (rectangle / lasso / magic wand)
Move tool: drag a layer
Layers: a new layer, Duplicate Layer, Merge Down
Free transform (Ctrl+T): scale / turn a layer
A layer mask: add one and paint on it
Filters -> Sharpen -> Unsharp Mask
✨ Generate into a selection (the AI panel)

groups.title: 2.533.0 — Dropdown lists inside a dialog open in front of it

items.title: 📁 next to a LoRA (Select a LoRA): the folder dropdown opens IN FRONT of the dialog, its search box takes typing, a click picks the folder
Settings: a long dropdown (e.g. the energy currency) opens its search list in front of the Settings dialog

groups.title: 2.532.0 — Tests tick themselves, docker title bar ▁ ⛶ ✕, House: select / turn / size, walk a camera

items.title: A job that finishes ticks its test by itself (auto ✓) - and it is still ticked after you restart the app
Things you used tick themselves too: Ctrl+K palette, a workspace, ↺ reset, 🪄 Furnish, ⌂ roof, 🧍 people, ⤓ .glb, 🎬 Every camera, 🩺 why it failed
▁ on a floating docker's title bar: only the title bar stays (▭ - or a double-click on the title - opens it again)
⛶ maximize: the docker fills the window between the menu bar and the statusbar; 🗗 puts it back where it was (docked or floating)
✕ closes the docker (its button / key opens it again)
🏠 ⬚ Select a sofa: drag a corner square to size it (Shift keeps its shape); the ↻ handle turns it (15° steps, Shift = free)
Drag on an empty spot: a box selects everything inside it; Shift+click adds / takes one off; drag one to move them all, R turns them, Delete removes them
Drag a 📷 camera through the plan: the 3D view looks through it as it moves
A camera selected: ← → turn it, ↑ ↓ tilt it; hold Shift - it rises (3 m over the roof at most); hold Alt - it sinks (the ground floor)

groups.title: 2.531.0 — Anima: the text encoder found or named

items.title: Settings -> Models -> ⤓ Model catalog -> 'Anima text encoder (Qwen3 0.6B base)' downloads qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors; restart ComfyUI
Anima (your animakimi_v13 in models/checkpoints) renders a picture
🩺 Style doctor on Anima before the download: the row names the catalog entry

groups.title: 2.530.0 — 🔍 the Ctrl+K command palette + 📖 Help

items.title: Ctrl+K (or 🔍 in the menu bar): type 'lora', 'house', 'depth map', 'negative' - the right dockers / windows / settings / guide sections come up; Enter opens it
A Settings field from the palette: the dialog opens on its tab with the field lit
A guide section from the palette opens the 📖 Help window (pick any section there)
Over the timeline's layers Ctrl+K still splits a clip (it does not open the palette)

groups.title: 2.529.0 — House builder extras (roof, trace a plan, furnish, .glb, shot list)

items.title: ⌂ Roof (nothing picked -> the House panel): Gable / Hip / Flat - an outside camera's shot shows it
🖼 Load a plan picture, 📐 set the scale with two points, draw the walls over it
🪄 Furnish this room (a room picked): the pieces against the walls, the door clear; with an LLM running it picks from the library
⤓ .glb opens in Blender / Unreal with its colours
🎬 Every camera: a StoryBoard scene per camera with the shot as its first frame + the list as .md

groups.title: 2.528.0 — 🧍 characters in House shots

items.title: 🏠 House -> 🧍 Person: press where they stand, drag the way they face; pick the character + pose in the properties; a grey mannequin in 3D
📷 Shot + maps: the mannequin is in the picture AND its depth map (for ControlNet)
✨ Make it real with FLUX.2 Klein edit (3 pictures) / Qwen Image 2.1 edit: the character replaces the mannequin, the room stays

groups.title: 2.527.0 — 🩺 the Style doctor

items.title: 🩺 (menu bar) -> ▶ Check (Quick): every image style gets a test picture; the table says which work
A style that fails shows the log line that matters and what to do (e.g. a model ComfyUI does not list -> which folder)
Real render: a style with its own steps + size (slower) - the times look right
The test pictures are NOT in the gallery or the Image assets afterwards (unless 'Keep the test pictures')

groups.title: 2.526.0 — the Workspace dropdown (Basic, Image editing, Video editing, Music video, Expert)

items.title: Workspace (menu bar): each of the five shows its dockers and hides the buttons it does not need; Image editing sets Generate to 🖼 Image, Video editing to 🎬 Video
Change a workspace (hide a docker, resize, open 🏠 House), go to another and back: it is as you left it
Expert: your old layout - every button is back
↺ next to the dropdown puts the workspace back to its default
Restart the app: it opens in the workspace you were in, its buttons still hidden

groups.title: 2.525.0 — a model ComfyUI's loader does not list is found where ComfyUI does list it

items.title: Krea 2 Raw with Krea2/jibMixKrea_v60CarolinaReaper.safetensors renders - if the file is in models/checkpoints the log says '-> as ComfyUI lists it: … loaded by Load Checkpoint'
Anima Aesthetic / Base render a picture (if not: 🐞 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B and send the report - its log shows which list it was looked for in)
A model in no ComfyUI folder at all: the error says it is in no list (checkpoints, diffusion_models, unet) and where to put it

groups.title: 2.524.0 — 🏠 the House builder (a floor plan you can use as a Location)

items.title: 🏠 House (statusbar) opens the House builder; 📋 Example shows a furnished house on the plan AND in 3D
Draw: ▭ drag a room (its walls come with it), 🚪 / 🪟 click onto a wall, 🛋 place a sofa (R turns it), ⇗ stairs after ＋ a floor; Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y
💾 Save: the house is in the list (with its rooms + m²)
3D: orbit it; ☀ Time moves the sun (noon = north), Lamps on at night; 👁 a camera's view - drag in it to aim the camera
📷 Shot + maps: the picture + its depth + normal maps land in the Image assets
📍 360° location: a new Location with the room as its 360° view (Locations docker; its @tag works in the prompt)
✨ Make it real (an edit style - Qwen Image Edit / Kontext / FLUX.2 Klein): a photoreal picture of the room, same layout
⤓ .obj: the zip imports into Blender (Y up) / Unreal (scale 100) with its colours

groups.title: 2.523.0 — a style's model can be a .gguf or a .safetensors

items.title: Krea 2 Raw GGUF style with a .safetensors model (e.g. Krea2/jibMixKrea…): it renders - the log says 'UnetLoaderGGUF -> UNETLoader'
A safetensors style (Krea 2 Raw / Turbo, Anima) with a .gguf model: it renders - 'UNETLoader -> UnetLoaderGGUF'
Anima Aesthetic / Base render a picture (if not: 🐞 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B and send the report)

groups.title: 2.522.0 — 🐞 the Bug report docker (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B)

items.title: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+B anywhere (even while typing): a screenshot of the window, then the 🐞 Bug report docker; again hides it
The screenshot: ✏ Pen and ▭ Box marks in red, ↶ Undo, 📷 Again (the docker hides for it), 📎 a picture of your own
⤵ Use the recorded steps: your last clicks, choices and shortcut keys with the docker they were in - never what you typed
👁 What is included: the system, each log's last lines, the steps, the settings with every key / token shown as •••
💾 Save report: bitgen-bug-….zip downloads (report.md, report.json, screenshot.png, logs/) - upload it to Claude
Earlier reports: ⤓ downloads one again, 🗑 deletes it; Settings -> General -> 🐞 Report a bug… opens the docker too

groups.title: 2.521.0 — checkpoint / LLM / vision fine-tunes in the trainer, ⧉ bake a LoRA into a checkpoint

items.title: 🎓 LoRA -> a job's Type: 🎨 LoRA / 🧱 Checkpoint fine-tune / 💬 LLM fine-tune / 👁 Vision fine-tune - each lists its base models (★ = recommended) with what it needs vs your card
An LLM or vision job -> ⚙ Install Unsloth: the queue job makes its venv, installs Unsloth + llama.cpp's converter and says it is ready
💬 LLM fine-tune: type a few examples or ⤒ Import a JSONL / CSV, ▶ Start - steps + loss in the Run tab, then a .gguf in the LLM folder (Settings -> LLM picks it)

auto.re: ^\[ft\] the fine-tuned model is .*Settings -> LLM picks it \(the assistant\)

items.title: 👁 Vision fine-tune: pictures + the answer under each + the instruction, ▶ Start - the .gguf + its mmproj land in the vision folder

auto.re: ^\[ft\] the fine-tuned model is .*Vision model picks it

items.title: 🧱 Checkpoint fine-tune (Lumina 2 / Flex.1 / FLUX.2 klein / SDXL): ▶ Start - the new model is in ComfyUI's diffusion_models/trained (Load Diffusion Model)

auto.re: ^\[lora\] the fine-tuned model is in ComfyUI's diffusion_models folder

items.title: A finished picture LoRA -> Run tab -> ⧉ Bake into a new checkpoint: pick its base model, strength, name - the new file is in checkpoints|diffusion_models/trained
An LLM / vision job -> ⤓ Export job: config.json + the dataset + ft_unsloth.py - runs on a RunPod pod with Unsloth
🎨 LoRA -> FLUX.2 klein base 4B: a LoRA trains (24 GB) and works with the distilled klein 4B

groups.title: 2.520.0 — LoRA trainer, peak / off-peak pricing + usage log, Remote GPU, packages in Settings, grouped downloads

items.title: Statusbar 🎓 LoRA -> ⚙ Install ai-toolkit: the queue job clones ai-toolkit, makes its venv + PyTorch and says it is ready
LoRA trainer -> ＋ New job: pick a base (Z-Image Turbo / FLUX / SDXL…), a trigger word, rank, steps; Save keeps it
Dataset tab: add pictures (upload, drag in, or pick from the gallery), write captions or ✨ Caption all with the assistant
Run tab -> ▶ Train: the queue shows step N/M + loss, samples appear, the LoRA lands in loras/trained with its Model manager card

auto.re: ^\[lora\] the LoRA is in ComfyUI's loras folder

items.title: Job tab -> 📄 YAML: edit ai-toolkit's config by hand; ✎ Use my YAML trains with yours, ↺ Back to the generated one returns to the form's
Settings -> General -> Energy cost: a peak price + ＋ Peak times (days + from/to); everything else is off-peak
A job run in a peak window: its ⚡ card / log splits peak and off-peak Wh and their cost
📊 Usage… (or click the ⚡ statusbar figure): days + jobs for a range, totals, CSV export
Settings -> Remote GPU: another machine's ComfyUI URL -> ✓ Test -> Use it; generation runs there, Local puts it back
Remote GPU -> RunPod: your API key lists your pods, start / stop one, Use it points the app at its ComfyUI proxy
Remote GPU -> SSH tunnel: user@host + key -> ▶ Open the tunnel forwards its ComfyUI to this computer
Settings -> Models: 🖥 This computer & package shows your card, the package installed and what each package lets you use
⬆ Upgrade to a bigger package: it installs what it adds + downloads its models in the background (log + progress there)
The models page (setup / Model downloads): a group's checkbox ticks or clears its whole group and shows its size

groups.title: 2.519.0 — daily supply charge, setup asks your hardware, packages

items.title: Settings -> General -> Energy cost: the daily supply charge is saved; a job's ⚡ card tooltip splits energy + supply
Setup (H3_SETUP=1 or a new install): the hardware card shows your graphics card, RAM and CPU - or asks for what it could not find
steps: Start the app with H3_SETUP=1 (or run setup again)
Check the card, RAM and CPU on the first page
Not right? -> pick your card from the list

items.title: Setup -> Next: the package page picks the right package for your card and lists what you can use (✓ ~ ✗, add later) and the download
Install the Editor package on a computer (or a test folder): no ComfyUI, no models - the studio opens and the editors work
node scripts/setup-cli.js --packages prints the packages for this computer

groups.title: 2.518.0 — queue presets, model manager, Civitai, energy cost

items.title: Menu bar: the ⏱ queue preset dropdown is there and lists Normal / Quiet / Eco / Cool-down / Max / Custom
Pick Quiet (overnight): ⓘ says the power limit was set - or why not (needs the app run as administrator)
steps: Pick Normal afterwards to put the default limit back

items.title: Quiet: two image jobs in a row - the second waits about 20 s ([queue] waited ... in its log)
🧩 Model manager: it opens (the 🧩 Models button in the statusbar) and shows a card for each model
Cards: thumbnail, name, rating, release date, model type (SDXL / Pony / Flux ...), category (image / image edit / video / music)
Hovering a card opens its description card beside it (cfg, steps, VAE, text encoder, keywords); moving off closes it
Select a model + a LoRA, tick Override the style - an image renders with them (its ⓘ shows the model + LoRA)
✚ New style from the selected model - the new style is in the Style dropdown and renders
✎ on a card: change its type / cfg / steps / keywords - it keeps them after ⟳ Rescan
Settings -> General -> Civitai: the key tests OK (civitai.red or civitai.com)
Model manager -> Civitai: a search shows cards with pictures
Download a LoRA from Civitai - it lands in ComfyUI's loras folder (no Save As) with its picture + keywords
Download a checkpoint - it lands in checkpoints (or diffusion_models when it has no VAE / text encoder inside)
🔍 Look up a model you already had on Civitai - its card fills in (picture, base model, keywords)
Settings -> General -> Energy cost: your price per kWh is saved
A finished job's ⚡ card / [power] line shows what it cost

groups.title: 2.517.0 — power draw, clock speeds, a job's energy, Anima

items.title: System stats: each GPU has Power (W) and Clock graphs (nvidia-smi found)
The GPUs' temperatures are read (queue presets need them)
System stats: CPU clock shows
A finished job has ⚡ … Wh on its card in the Done tab
Anima style renders an image (anima-aesthetic-v1.1)
Anima base style renders an image

groups.title: 2.516.0 — Krea 2, keyframes on any property

items.title: Krea 2 Turbo renders
Krea 2 Raw renders
Krea 2 Turbo GGUF renders
Krea 2 Raw GGUF renders
Keyframes on any property: key a clip's effect setting, ⚙ Compile - the movie matches the canvas

groups.title: 2.515.0 — theme edit keys, cut-out, camera tracker, fill

items.title: Ctrl+Shift+Alt+E enters theme edit mode (Settings dialog editable); Ctrl+S saves and leaves
AI cut-out through a shot: the subject is cut out on every frame and the compile keeps it
3D camera tracker: solves a real clip and a 3D card sticks to the scene
Content-aware fill for video: a removed object stays gone through the shot
